import json, urllib.request, time, re

RPC     = 'http://127.0.0.1:8545'
FACTORY = '0x5C69bEe701ef814a2B6a3EDD4B1652CB9cc5aA6f'
WETH    = '0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2'
BLOCK   = '0x18a9f4b'

def rpc(method, params):
    body = json.dumps({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':method,'params':params}).encode()
    req  = urllib.request.Request(RPC, data=body, headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    return json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20).read()).get('result')

def eth_call(to, data):
    return rpc('eth_call', [{'to': to, 'data': data}, BLOCK])

def has_live_pair(token):
    pad_t = token[2:].lower().zfill(64)
    pad_w = WETH[2:].lower().zfill(64)
    for d in ['0xe6a43905'+pad_t+pad_w, '0xe6a43905'+pad_w+pad_t]:
        r = eth_call(FACTORY, d)
        if r:
            addr = '0x' + r[-40:]
            if addr.lower() != '0x'+'0'*40:
                res = eth_call(addr, '0x0902f1ac')
                if res and len(res) >= 2+128:
                    r0 = int(res[2:66],16)
                    r1 = int(res[66:130],16)
                    if r0 > 0 and r1 > 0:
                        return addr, r0, r1
    return None, 0, 0

def get_source(token):
    url = f'https://eth.blockscout.com/api/v2/smart-contracts/{token}'
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'schlieren/1.0','Accept':'application/json'})
    try:
        resp = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=12).read())
        return resp.get('source_code') or ''
    except:
        return ''

def analyze_sell_cooldown(src):
    """
    Returns dict describing the mechanism if both sides found, else None.
    Two-sided test:
      BUY side:  writes state keyed on buyer (to) when from==pair
      SELL side: reads/requires state keyed on seller (from) when to==pair
    """
    sl = src.lower()

    # SELL-side read patterns (what we check on seller)
    sell_read = [
        r'cooldown\s*\[from\]',
        r'cooldown\s*\[sender\]',
        r'lastbuyblock\s*\[from\]',
        r'lastbuytime\s*\[from\]',
        r'lasttrade\s*\[from\]',
        r'lastsell\s*\[from\]',
        r'tradetimer\s*\[from\]',
        r'_cooldown\s*\[from\]',
        r'_lastbuyblock\s*\[from\]',
        r'_lastbuytime\s*\[from\]',
        r'transfertimestamp\s*\[from\]',
        r'antibottimer\s*\[from\]',
    ]
    # BUY-side write patterns (what we write for the buyer)
    buy_write = [
        r'cooldown\s*\[to\]\s*=',
        r'lastbuyblock\s*\[to\]\s*=',
        r'lastbuytime\s*\[to\]\s*=',
        r'lasttrade\s*\[to\]\s*=',
        r'tradetimer\s*\[to\]\s*=',
        r'_cooldown\s*\[to\]\s*=',
        r'_lastbuyblock\s*\[to\]\s*=',
        r'_lastbuytime\s*\[to\]\s*=',
        r'transfertimestamp\s*\[to\]\s*=',
        r'antibottimer\s*\[to\]\s*=',
        # also _recipient
        r'cooldown\s*\[recipient\]\s*=',
        r'lastbuyblock\s*\[recipient\]\s*=',
    ]

    sell_match = next((p for p in sell_read if re.search(p, sl)), None)
    buy_match  = next((p for p in buy_write if re.search(p, sl)), None)

    if not sell_match or not buy_match:
        return None

    # Look for a governing flag — anything like cooldownEnabled / txLimits / antiBotActive
    flag_patterns = [
        r'cooldownenabled', r'txlimits', r'antibotactive', r'antibotmode',
        r'transferdelay', r'limitsactive', r'transfercooldownenabled',
    ]
    governing_flags = [p for p in flag_patterns if p in sl]

    return {
        'sell_read': sell_match,
        'buy_write': buy_match,
        'governing_flags': governing_flags,
    }
